info.title: ASO Hub API
info.description: The Hub's HTTP API, as the console and the aso CLI use it. Send the ASO token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (run `aso token` on the Hub). Answers may carry fields not listed here; ignore what you don't know. Workers and the Architect talk to the Hub over the WebSocket at /ws and Git at /git/<project>.git instead.

version.description: `0.1.0+<build>` of the package this Hub serves

slot.description: Its desk, once the worker reported it

reason.description: Why work is merged on the Hub instead

rework.description: Why the work came back to an agent, as the agent is told

conflicts.description: Files left with merge conflict markers for the agent to resolve this round

at.description: When this agent started on it

truncated.description: Some patches were left out to keep the answer small

overall.description: failing if any check fails, else pending if any runs, else passing; none without checks; unknown when they can't be read

error.description: Why the checks could not be read

requirement.description: What to build, in plain words

force.description: Merge even when the pull request's checks are failing, still running or can't be read

message.description: What should change; the agent gets it as written
